title: Advances in triple-phase catalysis for energy and environmental applications
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00707K, Review Article
Xiaoying Li, Jinwei Xu, Yusheng Ye, Baoliang Chen, Xin Xiao
This review summarizes recent advances in triple-phase catalysis, including history, fundamental principles and interface engineering strategies for energy and environmental applications, highlighting the opportunities in studying soil triple-phase.
